scope: Development diagnostics only; no exported transform, hardware motion or qualification.

counterfactual_inputs.scope: Frozen-input counterfactuals; no execution, training or checkpoint modification.
counterfactual_inputs.interpretation: Only saved actor inputs change. Position error is rotated from the observed hand frame into world coordinates. Grip physical-units intervention emulates zero-mean normalization by physical jaw travel for position/error/reference; it changes no grasp command or physics. Report instantaneous arm-Jacobian linear velocity, excluding base velocity and servo dynamics. This is sensitivity evidence, not a rollout, causal success estimate or proposed runtime transformation.

inputs.scope: Witness-derived reset-only free-space diagnostic, not a TAMP replay or qualification.

suite.scope: Near-robot orientation-preserving translation development curriculum; preserve every prior case, goal, threshold and validation seed. New targets require physical teacher admission before training; not a hardware qualification.

public_grip_units.scope: In-memory jaw-input normalization diagnostic; no exported policy or qualification.
public_grip_units.transform: Emulate zero-mean normalization by physical jaw travel on measured position/error and reference only. Weights, task targets, feedback error features, physical state, history cadence and executor guards unchanged. No jaw feedback is falsified in the simulator. Diagnostic actor inputs differ from the admitted bundle; these episodes cannot qualify it.
